courses.title: Fire & Life Safety Awareness
courses.outcome: Notice everyday risks, review a private plan and rehearse a safer decision within awareness limits.
courses.outcomeMs: Kenal pasti risiko harian, semak pelan peribadi dan latih keputusan yang lebih selamat dalam skop kesedaran.

courses.title: First Aid / CPR / AED Awareness
courses.outcome: Rehearse a fictional response conversation and role handoff, then identify readiness and further-training needs.
courses.outcomeMs: Latih perbualan respons dan penyerahan peranan melalui situasi rekaan, kemudian kenal pasti keperluan persediaan dan latihan lanjut.
courses.alt: Illustrative CPR and AED learning image

courses.title: Online Security & Fraud Prevention
courses.outcome: Practise independent verification and carry out one permitted account or privacy review, or an equivalent simulation.
courses.outcomeMs: Latih pengesahan secara bebas dan lakukan satu semakan akaun atau privasi yang dibenarkan, atau simulasi yang setara.

courses.title: Community Emergency Preparedness
courses.outcome: Create and rehearse a private household readiness pack with clear information, communication and support arrangements.
courses.outcomeMs: Sediakan dan latih penggunaan pek kesiapsiagaan isi rumah secara peribadi, dengan maklumat, komunikasi dan aturan sokongan yang jelas.
